title: DeepSeek ka naya Flash model - MIT license
content:
DeepSeek ne chupke se ek naya model drop kiya hai.
And the weights are free under the MIT license.

Naam hai DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017.
Ye 17 October ko Hugging Face pe aaya.
The model card calls it a minor update to V4.1 Flash.
Par numbers minor nahi lag rahe.

Terminal-Bench 4.0 pe score 31.2 se 42.3 ho gaya.
That benchmark checks how well a model does real work inside a terminal.

Aur DeepSWE pe 74.2 se 77.0.
Ye coding tasks ka test hai.

Par asli twist yahan hai...
DeepSeek kehta hai ye model tasks JALDI khatam karta hai aur chhote outputs deta hai.
Shorter outputs mean fewer tokens.
Aur fewer tokens ka matlab... kam bill.
Agent ke liye ye bahut bada deal hai, kyunki agent ek task mein bahut saare steps leta hai.
Har step pe thoda bachat, poore task pe badi bachat.
This matters most when your agent runs all day, every day.
Kyunki wahan har chhota token bhi paisa hai.

Aur license MIT hai.
That means you can use it commercially, fine-tune it, and host it yourself.
Business ke liye ye important hai, kyunki data aapke apne servers pe reh sakta hai.

Ab reality check.
Ye scores DeepSeek ke APNE hain.
Independent tests abhi aane baaki hain.
Model card pe parameter count bhi nahi likha.
So test it through an API or a hosted provider before you buy any hardware.

Main aapko kya karne bolunga?
Apne agent ka ek real task lo... jaise ek bug fix ya ek weekly report.
Same task do models pe chalao.
Measure three things: did it finish, how long did it take, and how much did it cost.
Benchmark se zyada, aapka apna test sach batayega.
Write the results in a simple sheet so you can compare them later.
Agle mahine naya model aaye, toh wahi test dobara chalao.
Maan lo aapka agent roz sau tasks karta hai.
Agar har task ka output thoda bhi chhota ho, toh mahine ke end mein bill mein farak dikhega.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
